## Employment

2018-present Partner and Principal Consultant, January Advisors


2018 Co-Director of Research, Children at Risk

2017-2018 Assistant Director of Research, Children at Risk

2015-2017 Research Associate, Pew Research Center

2012-2014 Statistical Consultant and Graduate Research Assistant, Population Research Center at University of Texas at Austin

2011 (summer) Research Assistant, Pew Research Center

2010-2011 Teaching Assistant, University of Texas at Austin

## Education

2015 Ph.D. Sociology, University of Texas at Austin

2011 M.A. Sociology, University of Texas at Austin

2008 B.A. Religious Studies, College of William & Mary

## Methodological Expertise

Geospatial analysis, OLS and logistic regression, longitudinal data analysis (e.g., event history, panel series), multilevel/hierarchical modeling, demographic techniques (e.g., population projections), survey sampling methods

## Statistical Tools and other Software Training

R, Stata, Data visualization, Python, GIS, Tableau, Excel, WordPress
